```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has cut processing times significantly for those awaiting work authorization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Immigration decisions, including naturalization and work permit applications, are made fairly and as quickly as possible.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As of April 2024, the Administration achieved the lowest wait time for naturalization since 2016.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As of April 2024, the Administration achieved the lowest wait time for work authorization documents from certain categories of applicants since 2017.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In FY 2023, USCIS administered the oath of allegiance to more than 878,500 new U.S. citizens, including 12,000 members of the military.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"USCIS effectively eliminated the backlog of naturalization applications.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"USCIS reduced the median processing time for naturalization from 10.5 months to 6.1 months.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has partnered with state governments and non-profit groups to host Work Authorization Clinics.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Work Authorization Clinics have eased the burden on American communities by helping migrants support their families and move out of emergency shelter into more stable housing options.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration will help to fund community-based organizations that host clinics to assist with immigration cases.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
